name: ASMR Butter Models V1
summary: Two skinned butter models: CrunchyButter and StandardButter, with editable bones.
install: Import into ServerStorage, then copy the chosen model into Workspace. Preserve MeshParts and Bone descendants. These are model assets, not a complete ASMR interaction system.
limits: Static mesh/bone inspection only. No deformation animation, touch interaction, sound, collision or gameplay verification.
credit: Original supplied model names are preserved.
verification: Static Studio Edit inspection on isolated clones; no runtime behavior certification. Native instance counts/root names matched the supplied imports. Original scripts were disabled on static preview clones.
